title: Digital Identity and Professional Presence
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting digital identity and professional presence to resume before-after revision with truthful evidence, role fit, and AI-use note, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Convert a duty statement into an accomplishment statement built from a strong action verb plus a quantified, truthful result
Tailor resume claims to a specific role so a reader sees fit in the top third of the page
Disclose any AI editing help with a note that records what you accepted and what you rejected
Keep every claim defensible: write nothing you could not back up if a reference checker asked

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
